description: Date-stamped daily drop, e.g. file20260926.csv - four columns, the last one quoted.

file._note: Filenames carry the drop date, so there is no fixed name to match - selection is by pattern and file_name is left empty. match takes precedence over file_name anyway.
file._strategy_note: 'newest' ingests only the most recently modified match, which suits a scheduled daily pull. A drop missed while no run happened is skipped; backfill it by switching to 'all' or by naming its file_id directly.

format._quote_note: The source quotes only its non-numeric field (DDD arrives as 'A'), which is what a QUOTE_NONNUMERIC-style export produces. quote_char must therefore be an apostrophe, not the usual double quote - with " the quotes would be kept and DDD would be stored as the literal 'A'.

validation._note: AAA is unique within a single drop. It is not unique across drops, but each drop lands in its own table so the check stays valid.
